name: The Beast
source:
You're a super cool dyke with a sweet motorcycle and a reputation for being a ladykiller... but you owe your twin brother a huge favour for helping with your failing grades, forcing you to take his place on his high school graduation celebratory cruise.

[From the [url=http://ladykillerinabind.com/]Official Website[/url]]

[spoiler]Real name Lilian "Lily" Smith.[/spoiler]
